description:
[Trading Data API] ENS lookup on Ethereum mainnet in either direction: name to address, or address to primary name. — ENS lookup on Ethereum mainnet in either direction: name to address, or address to primary name.

**Example:** `/v1/chain-ens?name=vitalik.eth`

address.description: Optional. An address to reverse-resolve to its primary ENS name.

name.description: Optional. An ENS name to resolve (e.g. vitalik.eth). Either name or address is required.

name: chain_ens
